item: Row 288 batch 7: 25 test files whose seeds broke foreign keys now seed the parent rows and use the app's pragmas
summary: 27 bare create_engine calls in 25 test files move to tests/_app_engine.py::app_sqlite_engine. These files had inserted child rows (mentions, AI keywords, dated rows, alternates) naming articles, sources, keywords or merge batches that did not exist; each seed now creates those parents first, and no assertion changed. No failure came from app code writing a row without its parent. Six files stay bare because orphan rows are what they test (integrity sweep, bounded-read orphans, buried topic, keyword growth from mentions alone, outlet expressions, places in backups), and test_rollup_scan_plan.py stays bare until its DuckDB leg can be run locally. Two stale docstrings from batch 6 corrected. Converted files pass (294). The ratchet ceiling goes from 97 to 70 calls in 48 files. Test-only, no release line.
